decision.text: D4: THE RECORDED BYTES. _recorded_bytes(proof, sha) -> bytes|None: top = git -C proof.parent rev-parse --show-toplevel (None on failure); rel = proof relative to top; for each h in git -C top log --format=%H -- rel, blob = git -C top show h:rel (bytes, skip on non-zero); return the first blob whose hashlib.sha256 hexdigest == sha; else None. subprocess.run with capture_output, no text for show.

D1: RUNG 4 NO LONGER ASKS WHO ANSWERED. In reseal.ruling_refusal, delete the answered_by startswith('Akien') branch; an open- id lifts rung 4 when the question exists and is resolved. Update the docstring: outline 19.14.8.3, Akien 2026-10-31. The legacy-ruling branch is unchanged.

D6: CLI HELP. cli.py lines 47-48 read '--ruling <id>' as 'a resolved question, a confirmed ruling, or a ticket whose kind admits the change'; the --ruling argument help (around line 483) says the same: a resolved question id (open-...), a confirmed legacy ruling id, or a 12-hex ticket id (a bug whose fixes lists the proof, or a code-seam whose PROVES names it; the proof must name the ticket and every tooth it removed).
D5: TEETH. _teeth(source: bytes|str) -> set[str]: ast.parse; names of top-level FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef starting 'test_'; SyntaxError or ValueError -> set().
